definition: Wall time from first intro play to completed, 21-node call-first/home route. Craft confirmation is immediate. Every other node plays native authored duration; interaction uses explicit assistance, then complete 5–8 second showcase. No skip, fake clock, stored trajectory, or director sampling shortcut.
limitations: Chromium on this host, automated choices/assistance and immediate page handling; human reading/action/choice dwell varies.
Preparation, startup and result reading are outside performance duration.
Any native clock pauses are recorded and explicitly resumed; pause time remains in wall duration.
